summary: Retain Oracle publication receipts in GHCR and provide verified inputs for manual documentation catch-up.
userImpact: Operators can verify Oracle image publication when GitHub Actions artifact storage is unavailable and prepare a private documentation draft when automatic handoff is pending.
security: The publisher requires independent verification of the receipt signed by the protected workflow before reporting successful publication.

customerDocumentation.reason: This changes internal release evidence retention and keeps the customer image reference contract.

knownLimitations: Previously published images can be verified through their existing signatures, build provenance and SBOM attestations.
rollback: Use the retained signature and build provenance for an existing Oracle image digest.
validation: The release canary checks the exact Cosign commands and verifies the signed receipt against a scratch image digest.
